about: v84h top-down skill-tree panel as compact icon tiles (D2-style). Three trees sit side by side; each packs its 8-node path into a 2-column zig-zag so 5 through the 40-point ultimate stay on screen in phone landscape. js/ab-skilltree.js reads this. Node costs stay in data/skilltrees-*.json. Icons come from the skill-button pixel art (Tn / skill id) when present.
